Subject: March 30th Rail Switch Over




Shane,

On Saturday, March 30th, Ironclad will switch over rail logistics from Tasman Ridge to Coral at Boraline terminal.

To complete the switch over safely, we require a technical representative(s) from Tasman Ridge at Boraline terminal to oversee the operations and safeguard Tasman Ridge’s assets.

Please arrange for a Tasman Ridge technical representative(s) to report by 12:00 noon, March 30th, to the Main Gate at Boraline terminal and ask for Ironclad’s Ronald Martin. Jorge is leading all switch over activities.

If you have questions, contact me (details below) or Ronald Martin at +61 8 9216 6911, ext 2511.

Thanks and best regards.

Howard
